meta.description: OpenAEC SuperCloud: project files in spaces with members and roles, with versions, sharing and transfers. With the OpenAEC Desktop App you sync spaces with folders on your computer and install the OpenAEC tools.

header.label: Coming soon · project files and apps
header.title: OpenAEC SuperCloud
header.tagline: Sync, share and send project files
header.desc: The SuperCloud is the OpenAEC cloud environment: spaces with members and roles, files with versions, share links and transfers. With the OpenAEC Desktop App you link spaces to folders on your computer, work from File Explorer, and install and launch the OpenAEC tools as well.

notice.text: In development. To sync you need an account in an OpenAEC environment. The screenshots show an earlier version of the app; the macOS build and the menus on Linux and macOS have not yet been checked on a real machine.

features.label: Features
features.heading: Your project folders, the same everywhere
features.sub: Start with the highlights or pick a topic.

sync.title: Spaces linked to folders on your computer
sync.desc: Link a space to a local folder and the app keeps both the same as soon as something changes. When a file changes, only the changed blocks are sent. In a conflict the server decides and both versions are kept, so nobody overwrites anyone else's work.

share.title: Share with a role, send with a link
share.desc: Share a folder with a colleague as view, edit or manage, or invite a guest. Files and folders for someone outside your environment are sent as a transfer: the recipient gets a download link, optionally with a message, an expiry date and a password. An interrupted transfer resumes where it left off.

explorer.title: OpenAEC Cloud in File Explorer
explorer.desc: On Windows, OpenAEC Cloud has its own item in the navigation pane. Files can stay online only and are fetched as soon as you open them; status icons show what is up to date, in progress or locked. You share and send from the right-click menu, including the new Windows 11 menu.

more.title: OpenAEC tools and an AI assistant
more.desc: The Tools tab installs, updates and launches the OpenAEC desktop apps, even without a connection to an environment; every download is verified. In the assistant you ask questions of the OpenAEC AI service in the EU, with files attached.

sync.title: Two-way sync
sync.desc: Syncs as soon as something changes locally or on the server.

delta.title: Only what changed
delta.desc: On a change only the changed blocks are sent.

conflict.title: No overwritten work
conflict.desc: In a conflict the server decides and both versions are kept.

selective.title: Choose folders
selective.desc: Per link, sync only the folders you need on this computer.

ignore.title: Ignore list
ignore.desc: Your own patterns in .openaecignore, and safe handling of names Windows cannot use.

roles.title: Share with a role
roles.desc: Can view, can edit or can manage; never more than you are allowed yourself.

shared.title: Shared with me
shared.desc: What colleagues shared with you, with their name, your role and the expiry date, ready to link to a folder.

transfer.title: Send with OpenAEC
transfer.desc: Any file or folder as a download link, with recipients, message, expiry date and password.

lock.title: Locking and versions
lock.desc: Lock a file while you work on it and view earlier versions.

ondemand.title: Files on demand
ondemand.desc: Files can stay online only and arrive as soon as you open them (Windows).

icons.title: Status icons
icons.desc: Cloud, ticks and sync arrows per file and folder, plus who has locked a file.

menu.title: Right-click menu
menu.desc: Share and send from File Explorer, including the Windows 11 menu; on Linux and macOS send from the file manager.

tools.title: OpenAEC tools
tools.desc: Install, update, launch and remove desktop apps; open web tools in the browser.

assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.desc: Questions with attachments (images, text, PDF, Word and Excel) to the OpenAEC AI service in the EU.

updates.title: Automatic updates
updates.desc: A new version is verified and only installed after your click, never in the middle of a sync.

cli.title: Command line for servers
cli.desc: The openaec-storage program syncs spaces on a Linux server without a screen.

download.label: Download

whatsnew.label: New in v2026.44.10
whatsnew.title: An assistant, your own spaces and OpenAEC in File Explorer
whatsnew.desc: Released on 29 October 2026. What was added since version 0.8.1; the app now follows the year.week version numbers of the other OpenAEC tools.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.desc: A conversation with the OpenAEC AI service, with streamed answers, attachments and a choice of model.

spaces.title: New spaces and folders
spaces.desc: Create a space or a folder from the app and invite people to it right away.

guests.title: Invite guests
guests.desc: An unknown address in the share window is invited as a guest, if the server supports it.

explorer.title: OpenAEC Cloud in File Explorer
explorer.desc: Its own item in the navigation pane, with the spaces underneath.

menu.title: Windows 11 menu
menu.desc: Share and send now also appear in the short Windows 11 right-click menu.

session.title: Session and log
session.desc: The app renews its sign-in by itself and only asks you to sign in again when it has to; messages go to a log file.

what.a: The OpenAEC cloud environment for project files: spaces with members and roles, folders, files with versions, a recycle bin, share links and transfers. The OpenAEC Desktop App is the app you use to work with it from your computer.

start.q: What do I need to get started?
start.a: An account in an OpenAEC environment and the desktop app. After installing, you sign in through the browser, choose a main folder and sync the spaces you need. The Tools tab also works without an account.

platforms.q: Does it work on macOS and Linux too?
platforms.a: Yes: syncing, sharing and sending work on all three. Status icons, files on demand and the navigation pane item are Windows only. The macOS build and the menus on Linux and macOS have not yet been checked on a real machine.

conflict.q: What happens when two people change the same file?
conflict.a: The server decides based on the version your change was based on. In a conflict both versions are kept, so no work is lost. To avoid it you can lock a file while you work on it.

outside.q: Can I send files to someone outside my organisation?
outside.a: Yes, with Send with OpenAEC: pick files or folders in the right-click menu and the recipient gets a download link, optionally by email, with an expiry date and a password. A folder is sent as a zip. You can withdraw a transfer later.

ai.q: What happens to what I ask the assistant?
ai.a: Questions and attachments go to the OpenAEC AI service in the EU and use AI credit from your environment; the app tells you so before the first question. The conversations themselves are stored locally on your computer and can be deleted.

updates.q: How do I get new versions?
updates.a: Shortly after starting and then every six hours the app checks for a new version, downloads it in the background and verifies it against a fixed key. It is only installed when you click it, never in the middle of a sync.

source.a: The source code is public on GitHub, but it does not carry a licence yet. The Tools tab builds on the OpenAEC Installer.

tech.heading: Technology
tech.sub: For those who want to know how it is built.

tauri.title: Tauri 2 and SolidJS
tauri.desc: The desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux.

rust.title: Sync core in Rust
rust.desc: Without a UI, with BLAKE3 hashes per block and delta uploads.

storage.title: OpenAEC Storage
storage.desc: The server: a Frappe app for the administration, with the files in S3 storage.

cloudfilter.title: Cloud Filter API
cloudfilter.desc: Placeholders, status icons and the navigation pane on Windows.

auth.title: OAuth and keychain
auth.desc: Sign in through the browser; tokens are kept in the operating system keychain.

signed.title: Signed
signed.desc: Updates verified against a public key; the macOS build is notarised.
